metadata.description: Mods and skins for Claude Code: add-ons that change what you see and can do, and themes that change how it looks.

plugins.name: agent-monitor
plugins.description: A progress bar that fills as Claude works through a task, plus a panel with the plan and every subagent.

plugins.name: readable-layout
plugins.description: Lays the terminal out like a conversation: labeled boxes for you and Claude, quiet lines for Claude's work, bold text in color, a rule after every turn.

plugins.name: ember
plugins.description: A warm, low-glare dark skin with clear levels of emphasis, plus a matching Windows Terminal look and the JetBrains Mono font.

plugins.name: firelight
plugins.description: Themes in all three variants of ridusaini's Firelight palette (Coal, Smoulder and Ash) that also set the terminal's background to match, plus Windows Terminal schemes and the JetBrains Mono font.
